about_the_game:
Explore ancient Pannonia, master the art of historical medicine, and uncover the secrets of Late Antiquity in this narrative-driven RPG.

Rod of Asclepius is a historical RPG set in the 4th-century Roman province of Pannonia Secunda. You play as a Roman medicus, responsible for diagnosing, treating, and saving lives using authentic medical techniques from the era. As war and disease spread across the empire, your choices will shape the fate of those around you.

Blending exploration, turn-based medical procedures, and historical accuracy, Rod of Asclepius immerses players in the challenges faced by ancient healers. Investigate mysterious ailments, gather rare herbs, and balance the ethical dilemmas of early medicine.

Features

✅ Authentic Historical Setting – Explore archeologically researched Roman-era locations, customs, and medical techniques.
✅ Turn-Based Medical Challenges – Perform surgeries, mix remedies, and apply treatments in a strategic, skill-based system.
✅ Resource Management – Collect medicinal plants, tools, and rare ingredients to craft life-saving treatments.
✅ Isometric Pixel Art – A unique 2.5D pixel-art aesthetic that brings Late Antiquity to life.
✅ Investigation & Diagnosis – Unravel medical mysteries by questioning patients, studying symptoms, and making tough decisions.
✅ Morality & Reputation System – Your medical ethics influence how NPCs react to you and shape your standing in Roman society.

Can you survive as a healer in a collapsing empire?

The Medicine of Antiquity Awaits!

Wishlist now and begin your journey into the world of Roman healing.
